title: Sanitize patch ids and make the fence actually fence (VC-201-013)
goal: VC-201-013 refuted: patch_id is interpolated into the workspace path unsanitized — '../escape' and 'x/../victim' build workspaces outside the fence root or inside a sibling experiment's workspace, and ensure_isolated creates them; is_inside_fence is lexical starts_with so workspace/../outside reports inside; apply_in_isolation applies nothing and checks no target path (the installed-release guarantee is untestable); identical patch_ids share one workspace with no per-experiment isolation; PatchFence has no callers outside tests. Evidence: crates/susi-gawd/src/tests/vc_201_013_mastery.rs.
